name: The Hill Horror Reborn Helmet
description: Haunt your friends with this custom, high-quality reproduction of the terrifying helmet from the popular slasher vid 'The Hill Horror Reborn.' Inspired by the terrifying appearance of notorious serial killer Neville Lott, this collector's edition space-safe helmet replicates the killer's look in the second vid of the series with a black gunny sack and neon green lights. Now you can celebrate Day of the Vara in sinister style, while standing apart from other menaces.
